frozen: 2026-11-10, before any tuned arm was scored on the R1 cohort
finding_states: the four state names come from the single source in src/capability/core/statistics.py; the rule that assigns them to a column is this endpoint's own, declared in the third and fourth amendments (a band containing zero is bounded_negative when its larger end is below the controls' own performance), and does not follow the general lane rule stated there
fresh_bases_option: run --fresh-bases takes every base, the archived ProtGPT3-1.3B included, from fresh full-support scores instead of the archive; the declared reuse stays the default and its record is kept beside the fresh one (tenth amendment of docs/objective-alignment.md, digest 857f753a4a9c1ce7)

not_measured.zymctrl: the pair cannot carry a matched contrast (amendment of 2026-11-10 to docs/objective-alignment.md): ZymCTRL takes an EC class tag that ProtGPT2 cannot receive, scoring it without the tag is 1.73 nats off distribution (EXP-R2-034), and scoring it with one needs an exact-wild-type EC annotation that most R1 backgrounds lack, so its support would not match its base's. Not a cost decision.

cost_estimate.reading: L20, float32, one sequence per forward, 12-assay slice extrapolated to 25,929 sequences by a per-length line; the four admitted pairs cost 13633 s of single-L20 scoring in total (the archived ProtGPT3-1.3B base is reused, not rescored), the 10B pair being 71% of it, so no admitted pair is dropped for cost

instrument_floor.basis: Gaussian noise of the declared 1.07e-2 per-variant coupling spread added to the Potts column, controls and the ProtGPT3-1.3B reference refitted on the full support, largest shift in the family-mean rho of the controls and of both increments over 3 draws at the nominal spread; the 4x iteration-cap scenario is recorded for reference only because a capped background is booked incomplete and never used
